pr_metadata.title: fix(merge-review): make rule 11 implement the through-line protocol
pr_metadata.summary: vrg-merge-review-check rule 11 now accepts 'Diff read: through line <n>' (N, or N+1 on a newline-ended patch) and the old '<read> of <total>' form judged against the driver's own count, so it no longer refuses reviews that use the new protocol.
pr_metadata.notes: Merge review: done: eligible; accepted-risk 0. The patch-ending read is one shared helper in lib/merge_review/schema.py, used by the check CLI and by read_earlier_results; diff_file and fix_file moved there too. Docs updated for the through-line form and for --earlier-result reading the earlier patch.
